support_text: Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) was performed after epigenetic reprogramming of HepG2 cells with a 2.5 µM 5-azacytidine (5-AZA) regimen for 10 days versus untreated HepG2 controls, using microarray data from the GSE160648 data set. The IFNα response gene set was significantly enriched in reprogrammed (REP-HepG2) cells relative to non-reprogrammed cells, with a normalized enrichment score (NES) = 1.556, p = 0.009 and q = 0.018. Among the 90 genes composing the IFNα response gene set, 38 genes appeared significantly enriched, and IFNγ response and complement system signatures were also enriched.
